hidden_tests:
import humanize


def test_empty_iterables():
    assert humanize.natural_list(()) == ""
    assert humanize.natural_list(iter([])) == ""
    assert humanize.natural_list(x for x in []) == ""
    assert humanize.natural_list(set()) == ""
